clauses.title: Refund timelines and scope
clauses.clause_text: (b)(5) Where ticket refunds are due, providing prompt refunds, as required by 14 CFR 374.3 and 12 CFR part 226 for credit card purchases, and within 20 days after receiving a complete refund request for cash and check purchases, including refunding fees charged to a passenger for optional services that the passenger was unable to use due to an oversale situation or flight cancellation;
clauses.date_quote: Loaded into AsOf as in force from 2020-01-01.
